description: Check a parking session: lot, status, start and end times, rate, amount so far and extensions, with a link to the driver's session page. No API key needed: ask the driver for the 6-character phone code on their receipt or pass and the last 3 characters of their plate (session_id with session_code also works). Any mismatch gets one answer, SESSION_NOT_FOUND: ask the driver to check both. With an API key (sessions:read), session_id alone reads a session on your account.

phone_code.description: The 6-character phone code printed on the driver's receipt or pass. Ask the driver for it.

plate_last3.description: The last 3 letters or numbers of the license plate parked on the session. Ask the driver for it.

session_code.description: The session's code (sess_…), sent with session_id when there's no API key

session_id.description: Session id, from the driver's session page link. Without an API key, send it with session_code.

name: get_session
title: Get a parking session
